# SwimTrack Pro - Mobile App

A Flutter-based swim tracking application with team management.

### Key Features

- Training session tracking with custom events
- Multi-team management with coaches and members
- Training goals with progress tracking
- Meet management and event entries
- Profile management

### Development Commands

```bash
# Run app
flutter run -d chrome

# Run tests
flutter test

# Integration tests
flutter drive --driver=test_driver/integration_test.dart --target=integration_test/app_test.dart -d chrome

# Code generation
flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```
